newsitem.title: KENYA: Eight killed in plane crash in Kenya.
newsitem.headline: Eight killed in plane crash in Kenya.

text.p: Eight passengers and crew were killed on Wednesday when a plane crashed into hills west of the Kenyan capital Nairobi and burst into flames, aviation sources said.
The twin-engined Chieftain plane crashed in poor visibility near Ngong town in the Ngong hills shortly after takeoff from Nairobi's Wilson Airport en route for Mwanza, Tanzania.

"The pilot lost power from one engine shortly after takeoff and sent a mayday message saying he was in clouds and trying to get back to Wilson airport," said an aviation source. "A helicopter sent to the site said the wreckage was on fire."
The plane was operated by a Somali company. No details were available on the nationalities of the passengers and crew.
